---
title: "PhysioPipe report"
format: html
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(targets)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

This report is rendered by a `targets` pipeline: each table/figure below is read
from a target with `tar_read()`, so re-rendering happens automatically whenever
an upstream result changes.

```{r}
have <- function(x) x %in% targets::tar_meta()$name
```

```{r}
#| label: ecg
if (have("ecg_hrv")) {
  knitr::kable(tar_read(ecg_hrv), caption = "ECG — heart-rate variability (time + frequency)")
}
if (have("ecg_fig")) {
  knitr::include_graphics(tar_read(ecg_fig))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: eeg
if (have("eeg_power")) {
  knitr::kable(tar_read(eeg_power), caption = "EEG — band power per channel")
}
```
